annotation.summary_en: Publication ethics and malpractice statement of the Irish Journal of Applied Social Studies, based on COPE guidelines. It sets duties for editors, reviewers and authors. The text is unrelated to social robots in care, despite the collector title; the PDF contains only journal policy.
key_provisions_or_claims: Editors decide on academic merit, with blind peer review by at least two reviewers
Authors must ensure originality, avoid plagiarism and redundant publication
Conflicts of interest must be disclosed by editors, reviewers and authors
Data should be retained and accessible for at least ten years
Articles published open access under CC-BY licence
